name: Kirisaki Azami
source:
Abilities: Video Diary - Allows Kasumi to visually record the future and shows her what she will record on her diary.

The 13th Diary Owner who only appears in the PSP game. Azami is a generally rude person, mainly to the other diary owners, but is generally kind to her sister Kasumi. However, she can be social towards other people as well, including some of the diary owners. She's extremely overprotective of her sister and treats her like a daughter and will consider anyone who threatens to harm her, an enemy. Her motive for participating in the battle royale is to have revenge on Takao Hiyama, who attempted to murder Kasumi.

[From [url=http://futurediary.wikia.com/wiki/Azami_Kirisaki]Mirai Nikki Wiki[/url]]
